description: Owned two production models end to end — a churn classifier and a document classifier — including the Airflow pipelines that fed them and the monitoring that caught drift.
responsibilities: Built and maintained the feature pipelines the models trained and scored on
Set up offline evaluation that ran on every retrain, so a worse model could not ship quietly
Investigated production drift and retrained when the evaluation said it was warranted, not on a fixed schedule
achievements: Replaced a hand-tuned rules engine with a gradient-boosted classifier, and kept the rules as a documented fallback
Added per-segment evaluation that surfaced a model performing far worse on the smallest customer tier

description: Analysis and modelling for a document-processing product, mostly text classification and extraction.
